_doc: regression_due.py's map (LESSONS PR-2): each AI-player suite -> the NAMES of its evidence files in evidence_dir (case-insensitive globs) and the repo files it COVERS (case-sensitive globs; each must match a real file, and every module ai_player/ imports from this repo must be covered by every suite, or the tool exits 2). Initial map 2026-10-21 from the evidence names then on disk (step52 / step52reg / kb1-merge-units). COVERS were MEASURED 2026-10-21 (fix round): an import scan of ai_player/ resolves `modules` to sandbox-pokebot/modules/ (24 files import it), `scoring` to ai-agent/scoring.py (test_eyes, live_step1) and `mgba` to sandbox-pokebot/mgba/ (ignored by git: environment); the import closure of each suite's driver reaches brain/, host/ and those imports (revert_safety_gates runs test_safety_gates.py, which reaches 77 ai_player files, so it covers all of ai_player/, not only gates/); live_step5 runs the framework itself (launcher -> sandbox-pokebot/pokebot.py) and rate_step5 runs it in-process (play_harness), so both cover sandbox-pokebot/**. `exclude` mirrors provenance.EXCLUDED: evidence, Markdown and the seed ledger are not code under test. `reads` (round 2, 2026-10-21): the NON-CODE files a suite's driver reads and whose content can change its verdict, covered even when `exclude` matches them (a literal path must exist; a wildcard mirrors the driver's own glob and may match nothing yet). MEASURED by scanning the files each driver runs for path constants: units runs check_lessons (ai_player/LESSONS.md, ai_player/README.md + ai_player/readme/**/*.md, PROJECT KNOWLEDGE 06/07/08, the step-5.1 review note, CLAUDE.md), ledger_check and test_safety_gates' real-ledger test (ai_player/gates/ledger.json), and test_goals, which parses ai-agent/knowledge.py as DATA (BOSS_LEVELS); revert_safety_gates runs test_safety_gates in a copy of ai_player/ with the project's documents from this repo (its S0 control includes the real lessons list and the real ledger); revert_step5 runs test_goals in a copy. NOT covered, on purpose: the evidence folder and every other doc disk_budget / prune_evidence read to find CITED run folders (housekeeping: disk_budget's exit code is always 0, prune_evidence's tests use scratch folders), and the ledger for rate_step5, which WRITES it at its start and its end (pre-registration), so covering it would make rate_step5 permanently DUE after its own run (live_step5 has no ledger code: corrected 2026-10-21, recon Q6). EVIDENCE WITH A `covers:<suite>` CODE LINE (spec S4-1, 2026-10-21): `ai_player/gates/run_regression.py --full` writes <date>-regression-units.txt, <date>-regression-step5-revert.txt and <date>-regression-revert-gates.txt, each digested over exactly that suite's covered files (provenance.suite_digest), so regression_due can say ok; the other four revert drivers (step11, step2, step3, step4) have no suite here and go into the units file's appendix. `environment`: what git ignores but a run depends on (the emulator binding the installer downloads, the bot's profiles, backups, logs, caches): regression_due cannot see it change and prints it as a NOTE on every run.

revert_r1._note: R1 + R2 (build spec 2026-10-29 section 6, added 2026-10-29): runs test_saving and test_goals (and, for its gate and controller mutants, test_check_purity, test_safety_gates and test_host classes) in a copy of ai_player/, so it covers what revert_step5 covers; its data file ai_player/gates/revert_r1_mutants.json is code it reads (under ai_player/**). Its own evidence is <date>-r1-REVERT.txt, the regression runner's <date>-regression-r1-revert.txt.

rate_step5._warning: GRADED and needs the ROM: every run WRITES the seed ledger (ai_player/gates/ledger.json) at its start and its end, whatever --purpose, and graded seeds are single-use. Never run it as a routine regression (run_regression.py lists it NOT-RUN).
